title: High and low, loud and quiet

steps.say: Pitch is how high or low a sound is. Volume is how loud or quiet it is.

figure.alt: A bird with a high-pitched song and a lion with a low-pitched roar.

steps.say: Fast vibrations make high notes. Slow vibrations make low notes.
Short, tight or thin strings vibrate fast and play high notes. Long, loose or thick strings play low notes.

figure.alt: A guitar with strings of different thickness.

steps.say: Big vibrations make loud sounds. Hitting or plucking harder makes bigger vibrations.
Volume is measured in decibels (dB). Very loud sounds can damage your hearing.

check.prompt: A mouse squeaks. What kind of sound is it?

options.why: Low sounds are deep, like a lion's roar.

hints: Think about how a squeak sounds.
Pitch is about high or low.
check.explanation: A squeak is a high-pitched sound.

check.prompt: Hitting a drum harder makes the sound ___.
hints: It is the opposite of quieter.
check.explanation: Hitting harder makes bigger vibrations, so the sound is louder.
